citation.title: Evolutionary design of conductive pathways using a generative autoencoder
citation.authors: Matei Cristian Ignuta-Ciuncanu, Hannes Stark, Ricardo Martinez-Botas
citation.venue: International Communications in Heat and Mass Transfer 166 (2025) 109098 (online 2025-06-02; hybrid OA, CC BY per OpenAlex)
citation.version_coded: none: abstract only (OpenAlex abstract as stored in the pool); full text not reachable

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (abstract only). The abstract claims that a VAE coupled with evolutionary search lowers average device temperature by 10% and peak hotspot temperature by up to 1%, and raises Pareto hypervolume by 13%, compared with unnamed standard methods.

notes: Access attempts on 2026-09-24, all anonymous with a generic browser User-Agent and no personal data.
